name: Quick Reply
author: UnderStackDev
description: A separate quick-reply channel for repliable phone notifications relayed by KDE Connect. One bar icon that appears only while a message from a whitelisted messaging app is waiting; a panel lists each with a reply field. Does not touch the normal notification stream.

barWidget.description: Appears only while a repliable message from a whitelisted app (WhatsApp, Messenger, SMS, ...) is waiting. Click to open a panel with a reply field per message. Reply goes back through KDE Connect and the notification is cleared on the phone.

defaults.apps: WhatsApp, Messenger, Signal, Telegram, Messages, Viestit, SMS, Instagram, Element, Google Messages, Samsung Messages

schema.label: Reply-worthy apps
schema.defaultValue: WhatsApp, Messenger, Signal, Telegram, Messages, Viestit, SMS, Instagram, Element, Google Messages, Samsung Messages
schema.description: Comma-separated phone-app names. Only notifications whose app matches one of these ever produce the bar icon. Match is case-insensitive and partial. KDE Connect marks lots of apps repliable (X, Claude, ...) even when a reply is meaningless; this list is the gate. Empty = allow every repliable app.

schema.label: Dismiss notification after replying
schema.description: Call the notification's dismiss() after a successful reply so it clears on the phone and stops being re-forwarded. Only applies to notifications KDE Connect marks dismissable.

schema.label: Always show the icon
schema.description: Keep the bar slot even when nothing is waiting, so the bar centre never shifts. Off by default: the icon appearing is the signal.
